objective: Test whether a strictly constrained compact evidence vector can retain production decisions while reducing visible-label output tokens.

protocol.candidate_schema: required label-to-enum assessments plus required open-set unknown_candidates tail

failures.open_set_issue: The compact response proposed cargo_floor as an unknown candidate even though cargo_floor is already a registered known label.

decision.reason: The candidate was faster but changed known-label decisions on both images and regressed open-set registry discipline on one image.

preferred_work: preserve the full structured semantic protocol
retain adjacent-frame prefetch and exact caching to hide unavoidable cold work
re-enable the bounded 5090 route only after external workloads naturally release it

limits: Two samples are enough to reject this exact compact protocol because both failed the semantic gate; they are not a general latency distribution.
This result does not rule out model-engine acceleration that leaves the full output protocol unchanged.
No model weights, SAM3, VLM post-training, truth, training approval or OSS object changed.
